build_stereo_disparity_model: build a RAFTStereoModel to estimate disparity maps from left-right stereo image pairs
run_disparity_inference: run the RAFTStereoModel forward pass on a batch_dict with stereo_video pairs to get disparity
create_stereo_model_config: create a RAFTStereoModel with custom model_weights path and default hidden_dims and corr_levels config
review_RAFTStereoModel_forward: review the RAFTStereoModel forward method that pads inputs, runs inference with autocast, and returns disparity
test_RAFTStereoModel_initialization: test the RAFTStereoModel post_init that loads pretrained weights and sets the model to eval mode on CUDA
